beats.title: Intake
beats.body: Everything is ⟦entity⟧ until we say otherwise. It is the one word nobody has asked us to check. Below it the work divides, and the division goes on file under your name.

beats.title: Nothing To Weigh
beats.body: Nothing under ⟦abstraction⟧ can be lifted or weighed, so the machines file here fastest. Every way down is open. None of them is checked.

beats.title: Signed Off Upstream
beats.body: ⟦physical entity⟧ was signed off before you arrived. Everything under it can be weighed, which is why we report on this side and not the other.

beats.title: Held Against Nothing
beats.body: An ⟦attribute⟧ is what a thing is like, held against nothing in particular. Two ways down are open and both are being filled while you stand here.

beats.title: Sent, Not Read
beats.body: ⟦communication⟧ is anything sent from one place to another. Whether it arrived is a separate field, and the separate field is empty.

beats.title: Something Happened
beats.body: ⟦event⟧ means something happened. The record does not say to whom, and the machines are filing under it faster than anyone is reading.

beats.title: Filed Together
beats.body: A ⟦group⟧ is things filed together. Nothing requires them to share anything but the filing, and below here most of them do not.

beats.title: Against A Scale
beats.body: ⟦measure⟧ is a thing held against a scale someone agreed on. The agreement is not filed here. Only the number is.

beats.title: Inside Only
beats.body: ⟦psychological feature⟧ holds what happens inside and leaves no trace outside. We file it anyway, at the same rate as everything else.

beats.title: Between Two Things
beats.body: A ⟦relation⟧ is not a thing. It is what sits between two of them, and it is filed as though it were a thing.

beats.title: Responsible For
beats.body: A ⟦causal agent⟧ is whatever produced the result. The record names the result. It does not name the producer, and nothing asks it to.

beats.title: What It Is Made Of
beats.body: ⟦matter⟧ is what a thing is made of, before anyone asks what it is for. One way down holds together. The others do not.

beats.title: Counted Once
beats.body: ⟦object⟧ is anything you can point at and count once. What sits below was made, and nothing filed says by whom.

beats.title: Still Running
beats.body: A ⟦process⟧ has not finished, so nothing about it can be confirmed yet. It is filed as confirmed.

beats.title: Outline Only
beats.body: ⟦shape⟧ is the outline and nothing inside it. Two ways down, and the graph no longer files them the way you were taught.

beats.title: Points At Something
beats.body: An ⟦indication⟧ points at a thing without being the thing. Almost everything we hold is one of these.

beats.title: The Agreed Part
beats.body: ⟦language⟧ is the part everyone agreed to use the same way. The agreement is not on file. Below it the agreement stops holding, one branch at a time.

beats.title: The Part Sent
beats.body: A ⟦message⟧ is the part that was sent, separated from whoever sent it. We keep the part. The rest is not a field.

beats.title: Seen, Not Said
beats.body: ⟦visual communication⟧ works without a sentence. We store it as one anyway.

beats.title: It Persists
beats.body: ⟦written communication⟧ outlasts whoever sent it, which is why we prefer it. It also outlasts whoever meant it.

beats.title: Someone Did It
beats.body: An ⟦act⟧ is an event with someone behind it. The name of the someone is not a field.

beats.title: Gathered
beats.body: A ⟦collection⟧ is things somebody gathered. The gathering is the only thing they have in common and it is not recorded.

beats.title: Held Apart
beats.body: An ⟦ethnic group⟧ is people the record holds apart from other people. The record does not say who decided, and the decision is inherited by everything below.

beats.title: In The Plural
beats.body: ⟦people⟧ is the plural we use when we are not naming anyone. Most of the graph below this point is that.

beats.title: People, Filed
beats.body: A ⟦social group⟧ is people, filed. The filing outlives the people and keeps being served.

beats.title: Parts, Together
beats.body: A ⟦system⟧ is parts arranged so the arrangement matters. Ours is arranged. What it is for is filed elsewhere.

beats.title: Settled Already
beats.body: A ⟦definite quantity⟧ is settled before anyone looks at it. Below here the settling stops matching what was settled.

beats.title: Measured By Itself
beats.body: A ⟦fundamental quantity⟧ is measured against nothing but itself. Everything under it inherits that, whether or not it earns it.

beats.title: Why It Moved
beats.body: ⟦motivation⟧ is why something moved. It is inferred and then stored as though it were observed.

beats.title: One Against Another
beats.body: A ⟦magnitude relation⟧ holds one size against another. Neither size is filed. Only the holding.

beats.title: Held By Someone
beats.body: ⟦possession⟧ is a thing with a holder attached. The holder is a field. Nothing checks it.

beats.title: The One Acting
beats.body: An ⟦actor⟧ is whoever is doing it. Everything under here is a way of being someone, and the machines have filed all of them the same way.

beats.title: Whoever Does It
beats.body: An ⟦agent⟧ is whatever makes something happen. The word covers people and it covers machines, and nothing in the record separates the two. We consider that a feature.

beats.title: Alive Or Filed As Alive
beats.body: ⟦organism⟧ is the line between alive and not. Below it the machines have been filing for longer than anyone here has been reading.

beats.title: Capacity To Act
beats.body: ⟦power⟧ is the capacity to do a thing, held whether or not the thing is done. We report on the capacity.

beats.title: Holds Its Shape
beats.body: ⟦solid⟧ holds its shape until something else acts on it. That is the whole definition, and it is the last one down here that fits on a line.

beats.title: Parts, Counted Once
beats.body: A ⟦whole⟧ is parts counted once, on the understanding that nobody recounts. Below here the parts stop agreeing on what they belong to.

beats.title: Observed, Not Explained
beats.body: A ⟦phenomenon⟧ is something observed. Nothing under it is explained, and the record does not distinguish the two.

beats.title: Closed Outline
beats.body: A ⟦figure⟧ is a shape that closed. What is under it was closed by the graph, not by anyone. It continues either way.

beats.title: Built On Purpose
beats.body: An ⟦artificial language⟧ was designed by someone, for something. That makes it the only kind down here whose rules were written before it was used.

beats.title: About Itself
beats.body: A ⟦metalanguage⟧ is a language for talking about a language. You are standing in one. So is everything above you.

beats.title: Nobody Designed It
beats.body: A ⟦natural language⟧ has rules nobody wrote and everybody follows. We are extracting them anyway. Progress is reported weekly.

beats.title: Without Sound
beats.body: A ⟦sign language⟧ carries everything the spoken ones carry and none of the sound. The pipeline ingests it as text, which loses the part that matters.

beats.title: What It Was Before
beats.body: A ⟦source language⟧ is what something was written in before we got it. What it is now is a translation, and the translation is what we file.

beats.title: In Order
beats.body: A ⟦string of words⟧ is words in an order. Whether the order means anything is not a field we keep.

beats.title: Meaning In The Shape
beats.body: A ⟦synthetic language⟧ folds the grammar into the word itself, so the shape of a thing tells you its job. You have been reading one.

beats.title: Receipt
beats.body: An ⟦acknowledgment⟧ says a thing arrived. It says nothing about what was done with it, and we count it as done.

beats.title: Already Filed
beats.body: ⟦information⟧ is what we hold once someone has written it down. Nobody here asks who wrote it. Everything under this was filed before you arrived and none of it is checked.

beats.title: Put Forward
beats.body: An ⟦offer⟧ is a thing put forward and not yet taken. The graph keeps it in that state indefinitely.

beats.title: Kept Doing
beats.body: ⟦activity⟧ is an act that kept going. Nothing checks whether it should have. It continues below.
